+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ViewerUrlTimeoutError(RuntimeError):
+    timeout_seconds: float
+
+    def __str__(self) -> str:
+        return f"viewer URL was not captured within {self.timeout_seconds} seconds"
+
+
+class CapturingBrowser(webbrowser.BaseBrowser):
+    """Keep one-time viewer URLs inside the client process."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self._urls: queue.Queue[str] = queue.Queue()
+        self._claims: list[str] = []
+
+    @property
+    def claim_values(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+        return tuple(self._claims)
+
+    def open(
+        self,
+        url: str,
+        new: int = 0,
+        autoraise: bool = True,
+    ) -> bool:
+        del new, autoraise
+        fragment = urlsplit(url).fragment
+        if fragment:
+            self._claims.append(fragment)
+        self._urls.put(url)
+        return True
+
+    def next_url(self, *, timeout_seconds: float = 30.0) -> str:
+        try:
+            return self._urls.get(timeout=timeout_seconds)
+        except queue.Empty as error:
+            raise ViewerUrlTimeoutError(timeout_seconds) from error
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class TuiHarness:
+    app: SupervisorApp
+    browser: CapturingBrowser
